title: The dark side of AI generated influencers

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: AI influencers democratize content creation and offer diverse representation at scale.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: They exploit human psychology, spread misinformation, and erode authenticity in media.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: With strict content moderation protocols, platforms like Meta's Oversight Board can curb harmful outputs.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Deepfakes and synthetic media bypass verification, enabling manipulation and deepfake fraud on a global scale.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The dark side isn't just real—it's already reshaping trust in digital identity and media.
